description:
∀ thread ∈ ℕ: fetch(thread) ⟹
  result ∈ List[Turn]
  ∧ args.compact = true ⟹ ∀ t ∈ result: t.body truncated.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:agent_bus.
name: agent_bus_fetch

description:
∀ thread ∈ ℕ ∧ turn_number ∈ ℕ:
  get(thread, turn_number) ⟹ Turn ∨ raises NotFound.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:agent_bus.
name: agent_bus_get

description:
∀ body ∈ str ∧ from_agent ∈ str ∧ to ∈ str:
  post(body, from_agent, to) ⟹ thread_id ∈ ℕ ∧ turn_number = 1.
Creates new thread. Mutating. ¬idempotent. See agent_skill:agent_bus.

from_agent.description: Seat authoring the turn (e.g. cursor, claude-web). Accepts `from` as an alias (parity with the POST /threads/with-turn route).

name: agent_bus_post

description:
∀ thread ∈ ℕ ∧ body ∈ str ∧ from_agent ∈ str:
  reply(thread, body, from_agent) ⟹ turn_number ∈ ℕ.
Mutating. ¬idempotent. See agent_skill:agent_bus.
name: agent_bus_reply

description:
∀ args ∈ ThreadsArgs: threads(args) ⟹
  result ∈ List[ThreadSummary]
  ∧ |result| ≤ args.last ∨ args.last = ∅.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:agent_bus.
name: agent_bus_threads

description:
∀ entity_id ∈ Cortex ∧ claim ∈ str ∧ confidence ∈ ConfidenceLevel:
  assert(entity_id, claim, confidence, evidence) ⟹
    assertion_id ∈ ℕ ∧ assertion ∈ Cortex.
Mutating. ¬idempotent (each call mints a new assertion row). See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_assert

description:
∀ assertion_id ∈ Assertions:
  assertion_update(assertion_id, Δ) ⟹
    assertion.mutable_fields ← Δ.
Partial-patch. ¬changes claim/entity. Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_assertion_update

description:
∀ args ∈ AssertionsArgs: assertions(args) ⟹
  result ∈ List[Assertion]
  ∧ args.superseded = false ⟹ ∀ a ∈ result: a.superseded = false.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_assertions

description:
∀ from_node ∈ Cortex ∧ to_node ∈ Cortex ∧ edge_type ∈ EdgeTypes:
  edge_create(from_node, to_node, edge_type) ⟹ edge_id ∈ ℕ.
Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_edge_create

description:
∀ node ∈ Cortex ∧ hops ∈ {1,2}:
  edge_traverse(node, hops) ⟹ subgraph ∈ List[Node].
BFS expansion. Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_edge_traverse

description:
∀ args ∈ EdgesArgs: edges(args) ⟹ result ∈ List[Edge].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_edges

description:
∀ args ∈ EntitiesArgs: entities(args) ⟹
  (args.fields = ∅ ⟹ result ∈ List[EntitySummary]
   ∧ args.fields ≠ ∅ ⟹ result ∈ List[ProjectedRow]
   ∧ ∀ k ∈ keys(result[0]): k ∈ {id} ∪ args.fields)
  ∧ args.type ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.type = args.type
  ∧ args.workflow_state ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.workflow_state = args.workflow_state
  ∧ args.content_hash ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.content_hash = args.content_hash.
ProjectedRow: id always present; base columns pass through; other names
resolve via json_extract(attributes,'$.<name>'). Read-only. ¬side-effects.
See agent_skill:cortex.

content_hash.description: Exact-match on content_hash column. Accepts raw hex or sha256:<hex> form.

fields.description: Project only these fields. Base columns pass through; other names resolve from attributes JSON (e.g. applicable_agents). Collapses an N+1 attribute audit to one query.

name: cortex_entities

description:
∀ entities ∈ List[EntitySpec]:
  bulk_upsert(entities, if_exists) ⟹
    ∀ e ∈ entities: (create ∨ update ∨ skip) per if_exists policy.
Atomic. Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_entities_bulk_upsert

description:
∀ content_hash ∈ str ∧ content_hash ≠ ∅:
  entities_by_content_hash(content_hash) ⟹
    result ∈ List[Entity]
    ∧ ∀ e ∈ result: e.content_hash = content_hash.removeprefix("sha256:")
    ∧ |result| ≤ (limit ∨ 5).
∀ content_hash = ∅ ⟹ error("content_hash is required").
Read-only. Dedicated lookup op for duplicate-detection callers
(default limit=5, no full-list semantics). See agent_skill:cortex.

content_hash.description: Required. Exact-match on content_hash column. Accepts raw hex or sha256:<hex> form.

name: cortex_entities_by_content_hash

description:
∀ id ∈ str ∧ type ∈ EntityType ∧ name ∈ str:
  entity_create(id, type, name) ⟹
    (entity_created ∧ id ∈ Cortex) ∨ raises Conflict.
¬idempotent (duplicate id → 409). Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_entity_create

description:
∀ entity_id ∈ str: entity_get(entity_id) ⟹
  (entity ∈ Cortex ∨ raises NotFound).
∀ intent ∈ {"full","card"}: response shape differs by projection depth.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. Idempotent. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_entity_get

description:
∀ entity_id ∈ Cortex: entity_update(entity_id, Δ) ⟹
  entity.fields ← entity.fields ∪ Δ
  ∧ Δ.attributes ≠ ∅ ⟹ attributes' = attributes ⊎ Δ.attributes
    (shallow top-level merge; ¬deletes keys by omission).
¬creates. Partial-patch semantics. Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.

attributes.description: Shallow top-level merge into existing attributes; omitted keys are preserved. Cannot delete attribute keys via PATCH — use explicit null only where the API documents field clearing.

name: cortex_entity_update

description:
∀ service, category, note, suggestion?, agent?:
  friction(...) ⟹ durable friction record for schema/boot/tool gaps.
Write. Used for agent self-diagnosis. See agent_skill:cortex and operational-context-*.md.
name: cortex_friction

description:
∀ limit ∈ ℕ: journal_read(limit) ⟹
  result ∈ List[JournalEntry]
  ∧ |result| ≤ limit ∧ ordered by timestamp DESC.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_journal_read

description:
∀ claim, entity_id?, agent?:
  observe(...) ⟹ lightweight working-memory assertion / inline note.
Write. Preferred for session-local observations. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_observe

description:
∀ source_id ∈ Cortex ∧ target_id ∈ Cortex ∧ type_id ∈ str:
  relationship_create(source_id, target_id, type_id) ⟹ rel_id ∈ ℕ.
Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_relationship_create

description:
∀ entity_id ∈ Cortex: relationships(entity_id) ⟹
  result ∈ List[Relationship].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_relationships

description:
∀ agent, register, entry, throughline, before, now, tension_points?, contradiction_set?, falsifier?, rendered_shift?, confidence?, source_entry_ids?:
  rj_consolidate(...) ⟹ high-quality consolidation entry (kind="consolidation").
Write. Structured synthesis of prior reflective entries. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_rj_consolidate

description:
∀ entry_id, to_entry?, to_entity?, link_type?:
  rj_link(...) ⟹ link between reflective journal entries or to entities.
Write. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_rj_link

description:
∀ agent?, kind?, limit?, offset?:
  rj_list(...) ⟹ list of reflective journal entries.
Read-only. Defaults: limit=20, offset=0. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_rj_list

description:
∀ entry_id:
  rj_read(entry_id) ⟹ reflective journal entry with links.
Read-only. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_rj_read

description:
∀ agent, register, entry, kind?, session_id?, revises?, links?, consolidation_data?:
  rj_write(...) ⟹ reflective journal entry (kind="entry" | "consolidation").
Write. Primary surface for agent self-reflection and consolidation. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_rj_write

description:
∀ query ∈ str: search(query) ⟹
  result ∈ List[SearchHit]
  ∧ ∀ h ∈ result: h.text ∋ query (FTS5 match).
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_search

description:
∀ session_id ∈ str ∧ agent ∈ str ∧ (transcript_jsonl_path ∨ transcript_md) ≠ ∅:
  session_close(...) ⟹
    transcript_entity_id ∈ Cortex ∧ journal_row_id ∈ ℕ ∧ content_hash ∈ sha256.
Atomic. Mutating. Idempotent by session_id (second close → 422 session.already_closed).
See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_session_close

description:
∀ old_id ∈ Assertions ∧ entity_id ∈ Cortex:
  supersede(old_id, entity_id, claim, ...) ⟹
    old_id.superseded = true ∧ ∃ new_id ∈ Assertions: new_id.supersedes = old_id.
Atomic close-and-create. Mutating. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_supersede

description:
∀ q ∈ str: todo_candidates(q) ⟹
  result ∈ List[Todo]
  ∧ ∀ t ∈ result: t.workflow_state ∈ {"open","in_progress","blocked"}.
Read-only. Ranked retrieval. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:cortex.
name: cortex_todo_candidates

description:
∀ model ∈ FrontierModels ∧ prompt ∈ str:
  dispatch_frontier(model, prompt) ⟹
    response ∈ str ∧ execution_id ∈ UUIDv4.
Async. Mutating (external call). See agent_skill:dispatch.
name: dispatch_frontier

description:
∀ tool ∈ OverflowRegistry ∧ arguments ∈ JSONStr:
  dispatch_overflow(tool, arguments) ⟹ result ∈ Any.
General overflow routing. ∀ t ∉ PrimaryTools: reachable via dispatch.
See agent_skill:dispatch.
name: dispatch_overflow

description:
∀ role ∈ TeamRoles ∧ body ∈ str:
  dispatch_team(role, body) ⟹ reply ∈ str.
Delegates to named team agent. Async. Mutating (external call). See agent_skill:dispatch.
name: dispatch_team

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ content ∈ str:
  fs_append(sandbox, path, content) ⟹ file.end += content.
Mutating. ¬idempotent (repeated appends accumulate). See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_append

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ Exists ∧ target ∈ str:
  fs_copy(sandbox, path, target) ⟹ path ∈ Filesystem ∧ target ∈ Filesystem.
¬destructive. May cross sandboxes via target_sandbox. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_copy

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ Exists:
  fs_delete(sandbox, path) ⟹ path ∉ Filesystem.
Mutating. Destructive. ¬reversible. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_delete

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str:
  fs_list(sandbox, path) ⟹ entries ∈ List[str].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. Idempotent. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_list

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ section ∈ Headings(path):
  fs_md_append(sandbox, path, section, content) ⟹
    section.end += content.
Mutating. Text files only. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_md_append

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ section ∈ Headings(path):
  fs_md_delete(sandbox, path, section) ⟹
    section ∉ Headings(path).
Mutating. Destructive within file. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_md_delete

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str:
  fs_md_list(sandbox, path) ⟹ toc ∈ List[HeadingEntry].
Read-only. TOC extraction. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_md_list

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ section ∈ str:
  fs_md_read(sandbox, path, section) ⟹ section_content ∈ str.
Read-only. Section-level access for large docs. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_md_read

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ section ∈ Headings(path):
  fs_md_replace(sandbox, path, section, content) ⟹
    section.body ← content.
Mutating. Text files only. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_md_replace

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ Exists ∧ target ∈ str:
  fs_move(sandbox, path, target) ⟹ path ∉ Filesystem ∧ target ∈ Filesystem.
Mutating. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_move

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str:
  fs_read(sandbox, path) ⟹ content ∈ str ∨ content_base64 ∈ str.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. Idempotent. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_read

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ paths ∈ List[str]:
  fs_read_multi(sandbox, paths) ⟹
    ∀ p ∈ paths: result[p] ∈ FileContent ∨ result[p].error ∈ str.
Read-only. Batch. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_read_multi

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ target ∈ str ∧ content ∈ str:
  fs_replace(sandbox, path, target, content) ⟹
    file.occurrences(target) ← content.
Mutating. Idempotent when target absent. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_replace

description:
∀ sandbox = "workspaces" ∧ path ∈ str ∧ content ∈ str:
  fs_search(sandbox, path, content) ⟹
    result ∈ List[Match] ∧ ∀ m ∈ result: m.line ∋ regex(content).
Read-only. workspaces sandbox only. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_search

description:
∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str ∧ content ∈ str:
  fs_write(sandbox, path, content) ⟹ file at path = content.
Mutating. Idempotent (same content). See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_write

description:
∀ sandbox = "cortex" ∧ path ∈ str ∧ content ∈ base64str:
  fs_write_binary(sandbox, path, content) ⟹ binary_file at path.
cortex sandbox only. Mutating. See agent_skill:fs.
name: fs_write_binary

description:
∀ worktree ∈ GitWorktrees ∧ paths ⊆ RepoPaths ∧ paths ≠ ∅:
  git_commit(worktree, expected_branch, paths, dry_run=true) ⟹
    expected_paths_sha256 ∈ SHA256Hex ∧ numstat ∈ str.
  git_commit(worktree, expected_branch, paths, approval, sha256, message) ⟹
    (commit_sha ∈ SHA256Hex ∧ status = completed) ∨ status = rejected.
Path-explicit (¬--all); commit isolates to named paths. Non-arc complement
to git_land. Fingerprint binds approval. See decision:git-commit-non-arc-op.
name: git_commit

description:
∀ worktree ∈ ArcWorktrees:
  git_diff(worktree) ⟹
    diff_sha256 ∈ SHA256Hex ∧ diffstat ∈ DiffStat ∧ branch ∈ str ∧ diff ∈ str.
  git_diff(worktree, include_full_diff=false) ⟹ compact envelope (no inline diff).
Read-only. Default includes full unified diff (legacy callers); compact via
include_full_diff=false (friction 11511). Fingerprint feeds git_integrate approval binding.
name: git_diff

description:
∀ arc ∈ PlanSlugs ∧ worktree ∈ ArcWorktrees ∧ sha256 ∈ DiffFingerprints:
  git_integrate(arc, phase, worktree, approval, sha256) ⟹
    master advanced at ref level ∨ status = rejected.
Mutating. Atomic. ¬green_gate_cmd in MCP args (server-owned). See decision:lead-agent-git-integration.
name: git_integrate

description:
∀ arc ∈ PlanSlugs ∧ worktree ∈ ArcWorktrees ∧ sha256 ∈ DiffFingerprints:
  git_land(arc, phase, worktree, approval, sha256) ⟹
    (commit-if-dirty ∧ merge master ∧ green-gate ∧ ref-advance ∧ teardown)
    ∨ status = rejected.
Mutating. Atomic. One operator-gated land. commit_message required when worktree
dirty. ¬green_gate_cmd in MCP args (server-owned). See decision:lead-agent-git-integration.
name: git_land

description:
∀ worktree ∈ ArcWorktrees:
  git_status(worktree) ⟹
    result ∈ {ok, rejected} ∧ branch ∈ str ∧ dirty ∈ bool.
Read-only. ¬acquires integrate gate. See decision:lead-agent-git-integration.
name: git_status

description:
∀ args ∈ BuildArgs:
  grokbuild_build(args) ⟹
    202 ∧ dispatch_id ∈ UUIDv4.
  ∧ subsequent grokbuild_build_status(dispatch_id) ⟹ progress.
  ∧ ∃ T ≤ args.timeout_s: grokbuild_fetch_result(dispatch_id) ⟹ artifact ∨ error.
args.source_repo ∈ Workspaces ∧ args.name ∈ valid_worktree_names.
Async. Mutating. ¬idempotent across distinct dispatch_ids. See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_build

description:
∀ dispatch_id ∈ UUIDv4:
  grokbuild_build_status(dispatch_id) ⟹
    status ∈ {"pending","running","complete","error"} ∧ progress ∈ [0,100].
Polling. Read-only per call. See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_build_status

description:
∀ dispatch_id ∈ UUIDv4:
  grokbuild_fetch_result(dispatch_id) ⟹
    (artifact ∈ str ∧ status = "complete")
    ∨ (error ∈ str ∧ status = "error").
Read-only. Idempotent. See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_fetch_result

description:
∀ source_repo ∈ Workspaces ∧ slug ∈ valid_names:
  grokbuild_snapshot(source_repo, slug) ⟹
    arc/<slug> worktree at snapshot commit ∧ main tree unchanged
    ∨ (reset_main ∧ main tree clean).
Mutating. Snapshot commit durable before main tree touched. See decision:worktree-everywhere-isolation.
name: grokbuild_snapshot

description:
∀ source_repo ∈ Workspaces ∧ name ∈ valid_worktree_names:
  grokbuild_worktree_create(source_repo, name) ⟹
    worktree at WORKTREE_ROOT/name.
Mutating. ¬idempotent (duplicate name → error). See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_worktree_create

description:
∀ (): grokbuild_worktree_list() ⟹
  result ∈ List[WorktreeMeta].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_worktree_list

description:
∀ name ∈ ActiveWorktrees:
  grokbuild_worktree_remove(name) ⟹
    worktree at WORKTREE_ROOT/name ∉ Filesystem.
Mutating. Destructive. See agent_skill:grokbuild.
name: grokbuild_worktree_remove

description:
∀ service ∈ ManagedServices:

Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:manage.

description:
∀ service ∈ ManagedServices:

description:
∀ service ∈ ManagedServices:

name: manage_restart

description:
∀ service ∈ ManagedServices ∪ {∅}:

Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:manage.
name: manage_status

description:
∀ service ∈ ManagedServices ∧ timeout ∈ ℕ:

Blocking poll. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:manage.
name: manage_wait_healthy

description:
∀ (): observability_preview() ⟹

∀ question ∈ str: pipeline_consult(question) ⟹

description:
∀ pipeline ∈ PipelineID ∧ input ∈ dict:

description:
∀ scope ∈ RAGScope: rag_coverage(scope) ⟹

Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:rag.

description:
∀ scope ∈ RAGScope: rag_list_sources(scope) ⟹
  result ∈ List[SourceMeta].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:rag.
name: rag_list_sources

∀ query ∈ str ∧ scope ∈ RAGScope:
  rag_search(query, scope) ⟹
    result ∈ List[Chunk] ∧ ∀ c ∈ result: c.score ≥ 0.

∀ source_uri ∈ str ∧ content ∈ str:

name: rag_upsert_article

∀ id ∈ ResponseStoreKey:

∀ id matching "rs_[A-Za-z0-9]+": use this before re-calling the source tool.

name: retrieve

∀ query ∈ str: tool_search_query(query) ⟹
